terms.definition: Data organized into rows and columns for easy reading.
terms.function: Stores and presents data points in a grid.
terms.whyItMatters: Tables are how the world records and shares data.

terms.definition: A horizontal line of cells — one full record.
terms.function: Holds one item's data across all columns.
terms.whereItIs: One horizontal strip of the grid.
terms.whyItMatters: Tracing a row shows everything about one item.

terms.definition: A vertical line of cells — one attribute.
terms.function: Holds one kind of value for every record.
terms.whereItIs: The vertical strips of the grid.
terms.whyItMatters: Columns let you compare the same attribute across items.

terms.definition: The top row naming each column.
terms.function: Tells you what each column holds.
terms.whereItIs: The top strip of the table.
terms.whyItMatters: Without headers, cells have no meaning.
